measure.measure_definition: Time to event: randomization to death from any cause; Participants; Primary end point in the ITT population; survival estimated by the Kaplan-Meier method; groups compared with a two-sided log-rank test; stratified hazard ratio reported.; Time origin is randomization. Event is death from any cause. Patients not known to have died at analysis are censored at the last date known alive; patients without post-baseline information are censored at randomization (Supplement 2, endpoint definitions and statistical methods). Stratification factors: age (≤70 v >70 years), number of prior lines of systemic therapy (1 v ≥2), and outcome of last systemic therapy (relapsed v refractory).

Time to event: randomization to investigator-assessed disease progression or death from any cause, whichever occurs first; Participants; Investigator-assessed; survival estimated by the Kaplan-Meier method; groups compared with a two-sided log-rank test; stratified hazard ratio reported. Response assessment used PET-CT at screening, PET-CT or CT at mid-treatment, PET-CT at end of treatment, and CT every 6 months during long-term follow-up until progression or end of study, whichever occurred first. A full tumor assessment was performed whenever progression or relapse was suspected; the exact mid-treatment assessment date is not specified in this supplementary methods description.; Time origin is randomization. Event is investigator-assessed disease progression or death from any cause, whichever occurs first. Censored at earliest non-protocol-specified antilymphoma treatment (NALT) or two or more missing tumor assessments. Stratification factors: age (≤70 v >70 years), number of prior lines of systemic therapy (1 v ≥2), and outcome of last systemic therapy (relapsed v refractory).

Occurrence: overall response (complete response or partial response) at end of treatment by IRC; Participants; PET-CT at end of treatment, assessed by the Independent Review Committee (IRC) per Lugano criteria; 95% CI estimated with the Clopper-Pearson method; response rates compared with a stratified Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test.; Overall response at EOT includes complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) per Lugano criteria. Supplement 2 explicitly defines ORR as the proportion achieving a complete or partial metabolic response on PET-CT at end of treatment; this selected result uses IRC assessment. Denominator is the randomized ITT population.
measure.measure_name: Overall response rate at end of treatment, IRC-assessed

population.intervention: Polatuzumab vedotin plus rituximab, gemcitabine, and oxaliplatin (Pola-R-GemOx)
population.intervention_regimen: Polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg; rituximab 375 mg/m2; gemcitabine 1,000 mg/m2; oxaliplatin 100 mg/m2; Intravenous, every 21 days for up to eight cycles; primary G-CSF and anti-infective prophylaxis against Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia and herpes simplex virus were mandatory.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment assignment: Pola-R-GemOx; Adults (≥18 years) with histologically confirmed relapsed or refractory DLBCL, not otherwise specified, or a history of transformation of indolent disease to DLBCL; ≥1 prior line of systemic treatment; ineligible for autologous or allogeneic stem cell transplantation or CAR T-cell therapy at recruitment; randomly assigned 1:1 to Pola-R-GemOx. The ITT population includes all randomly assigned patients regardless of actual treatment received.
population.population_time_frame: Enrolment between February 7, 2020 and May 23, 2023; primary/final analysis with median follow-up 24.6 months (range, 0-34) for OS.

population.population_definition: Randomized cohort, both treatment groups combined (parent population); All patients randomly assigned 1:1 to Pola-R-GemOx or R-GemOx in the randomized phase; includes all randomly assigned patients regardless of actual treatment received.
